criteria.acceptance_checks: Homepage, plans, start and explorer agree on seat limits, included modules, add-on prices and offer terms.
criteria.reason: Homepage/plans/start/explorer/parent agree on $499 setup + $299/month and conditional text/email/AI usage fees, included core branches and separate unpriced premium software. criteria.reason: Public choices intersect explicit Simple core keys with safe visibility and reject premium/internal/retired selections. Marketplace remains default-off/internal, separately priced, with no marketing-triggered activation. Premium owned/gated/readiness distinctions remain incomplete in the signed-in settings cards (F07).

evidence_coverage_definition: Weight of assessed rubric criteria, not line/branch/route/automated-test coverage.
gate_assessment: No new critical regression observed in the bounded evidence. Genuine provider/restore/device and commercial activation acceptance remain launch prerequisites, not passed checks.
readiness_assessment: Improved guided-use release is live and its defined synthetic/public contracts pass. This score does not establish unrestricted premium/provider rollout or end-to-end production customer acceptance.
